issue.title: Monday athena job drafts closed period Reviews once pilot drafts prove useful

task_type_fields.proposal: An athena job that runs every Monday and drafts the `## Review` of each closed week whose Review is still `empty`, plus each closed quarter on the first Monday of a new quarter and the closed year on the second Monday of January, by launching an agent with the note's own instructions ("Update 2026/2026-W45.md") so it takes every number from `bob periods brief <id> -f md` and saves only through `bob periods draft`. Enable it only after four pilot weeks in which at least 50% of agent drafts were kept or edited (review state `drafted`/`edited`/`reflected`, not deleted). Proposed by bob-cli-gh.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1); the epic plan's rollout phase asked for this automation follow-up to be filed. Evidence: plan:202611/period_notes_and_stats_strips.md (rollout phase), pilot drafts for 2026-W44 and 2026-Q3 committed in the vault by bob-cli-gh.9.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-gh epic deliberately shipped manual review rituals (gtd_daily.md Monday weekly review, calendar-anchored quarterly and yearly reviews) and two pilot drafts; it never scoped unattended agent launches. Whether automation is worth it depends on four weeks of pilot evidence that does not exist yet.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-gh.9 proposed automating weekly, quarterly, and yearly Review drafts; the period-notes epic only shipped manual rituals and pilot drafts.
